title: raphael-web2api built-in skill configuration
description: Configuration items for the raphael-web2api (Raphael AI) image generation proxy. Effective config = defaults -> user file (<opc_home>/config/raphael-web2api.yaml) -> CLI flags.

install_dir.description: Where the server venv and runtime files live. Empty string resolves to <opc_home>/integrations/raphael-web2api at runtime.

headless.description: Run the Playwright browser headless. Set false if Cloudflare Turnstile ever blocks headless access.

cookies_path.description: Path to a JSON cookies export of a logged-in raphael.app session (raises the anonymous 2/day limit). Empty = anonymous.

pw_browsers_path.description: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH override. Empty falls back to the environment default (the hermes ms-playwright build on this machine).

proxies.description: Pool of upstream proxy URLs for egress-IP rotation (the anon 2/day limit is per source IP). Each entry is a proxy URL; use "direct" or "" for a direct connection. Empty = use the system proxy (single egress).

rotate_proxies.description: Round-robin over the proxy pool and auto-retry on ANON_DAILY_LIMIT by switching egress IP.

max_proxy_retries.description: Max generation attempts across proxies before giving up.

auto_launch.description: Launch the proxy automatically when 'opc-raphael-web2api start' runs.

open_page.description: Open the proxy's health page in the browser after launch.
